description: Removes the background from one image with BackGone’s production engine and returns a transparent PNG (or WebP) inline. Costs 1 API credit on success; failed calls are not charged. Requires an API key sent as "Authorization: Bearer sk_..." — create one at https://backgone.com/settings/apikeys and top up API credits at https://backgone.com/pricing. Provide exactly one of image_url or image_base64.

format.description: Output format. PNG is the default; WebP is smaller and capped at a lower megapixel limit.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (PNG, JPEG or WebP; up to 10 MB). A data: URL prefix is also accepted. Use this when the image is local to the agent.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of a PNG, JPEG or WebP image. Fetched server-side with SSRF protection.

name: remove_background
title: Remove an image background
